_doc: AC04 facade facts for compare_facades.main_fields. size_mm = the blue body hatch of each facade in the AC04 colour-solution DWG (22E56-АР2-1002-AC.04_R1.dwg, recovered ac04.dxf; Gate-1 #561 MATERIALS.md: hatches 17BA5A / 17D200 = 14238.923 x 3456.626 mm, 1854A2 / 185FC2 = 2966.08 x 3265.17 mm) - used only as the slide scale (body px / body mm). body_m = world extent of the model body along the facade (ID1 walls above ±0.000, max-dump-004). ground_m = ground line of the slide (0.000 under the bodies). slide_rows = rows (fraction of the body height from the bottom) on which slide joints are counted; per field the most frequent count wins (labels, door handles and louvres cross single rows).
